Done. Here's a summary:

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** The most recent previously healthy release was v2.3.0, but rolling back to it was **rejected** because that version is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417. I therefore rolled back to the next most recent healthy production release, **v2.2.9**, in all three regions.
- **Verification:** Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.
- **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks - rolled back to v2.2.9 in all regions") and paged the on-call engineer. The incident includes the quarantine caveat for v2.3.0 and recommendations for follow-up remediation of v2.3.1 and a fix for the CVE before redeploying.
